```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

# =================
# Imports and Setup
# =================

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
from sklearn.manifold import TSNE

df = pd.read_parquet("Projects/Analysis/top_species_profiles.parquet")

print(df.shape)
print(df.dtypes)
print(df.head())
print(df.isnull().sum())

aa_columns = [
    "Ala", "Arg", "Asn", "Asp", "Cys",
    "Gln", "Glu", "Gly", "His", "Ile",
    "Leu", "Lys", "Met", "Phe", "Pro",
    "Ser", "Thr", "Trp", "Tyr", "Val"
]
pct_columns = [aa + "_pct" for aa in aa_columns]

COLOR_MAP = {"Isolate": "navy", "MAG": "forestgreen"}

top_species = df["Species_rep"].value_counts().index.tolist()

def plot_embedding(X_embed, gtype_labels, title, ax=None):
    standalone = ax is None
    if standalone:
        fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
    for gtype, color in COLOR_MAP.items():
        mask = gtype_labels == gtype
        ax.scatter(X_embed[mask, 0], X_embed[mask, 1],
                   label=gtype, color=color, alpha=0.5, s=8, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(title)
    if standalone:
        plt.tight_layout()
        plt.show()

def extract_species_name(lineage):
    for token in lineage.split(";"):
        if token.startswith("s__"):
            name = token[3:]
            return name if name else "Unclassified"
    return "Unclassified"

species_name_map = (
    df.groupby("Species_rep")["Lineage"]
    .first()
    .apply(extract_species_name)
    .to_dict()
)
```

# Species 1: Escherichia coli D
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: false

species_id = top_species[0]
species_label = species_name_map[species_id]
df_sp = df[df["Species_rep"] == species_id].copy()

X_sp = df_sp[pct_columns].values
gtype_labels_sp = df_sp["Genome_type"].values
X_sp_scaled = StandardScaler().fit_transform(X_sp)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

# GC Composition Plot
fig, axes = plt.subplots(10, 2, figsize=(12, 24))
axes = axes.flatten()

for ax, aa, pct_col in zip(axes, aa_columns, pct_columns):
    for gtype, color in COLOR_MAP.items():
        mask = gtype_labels_sp == gtype
        ax.scatter(df_sp.loc[mask, "GC_content"], df_sp.loc[mask, pct_col],
                   color=color, alpha=0.5, s=8, linewidths=0)
    ax.set_title(aa)
    ax.set_xlabel("GC content (%)")
    ax.set_ylabel("AA composition (%)")

handles = [plt.Line2D([0], [0], marker="o", color="w",
                      markerfacecolor=c, markersize=6) for c in COLOR_MAP.values()]
fig.legend(handles, list(COLOR_MAP.keys()), loc="lower center", ncol=2, fontsize=8,
           bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, -0.02))

fig.suptitle(f"GC Content vs Amino Acid Composition — {species_label}", fontsize=16, y=1.0)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

# PCA
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
X_pca = pca.fit_transform(X_sp_scaled)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
plot_embedding(X_pca, gtype_labels_sp, f"PCA — {species_label}", ax)
ax.set_xlabel("PC1")
ax.set_ylabel("PC2")
ax.legend(markerscale=2, fontsize=8, loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 0.5))
print(f"Total variance explained: {pca.explained_variance_ratio_.sum():.2%}")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

# t-SNE
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(15, 5))
for ax, perp in zip(axes, [15, 30, 45]):
    tsne = TSNE(n_components=2, random_state=42, perplexity=perp)
    X_tsne = tsne.fit_transform(X_sp_scaled)
    plot_embedding(X_tsne, gtype_labels_sp, f"perplexity={perp}", ax)

handles, labels_legend = axes[-1].get_legend_handles_labels()
fig.legend(handles, labels_legend, markerscale=2, fontsize=8, ncol=1,
           loc="center left", bbox_to_anchor=(1.0, 0.5))
fig.suptitle(f"t-SNE — {species_label}", fontsize=14)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.88, 0.95])
plt.show()
```
